analysis: Karim Benzema delivered a clinical performance, converting three chances to secure a hat-trick that highlights his lethal finishing and ability to capitalize on service from Vinícius Júnior and Modrić. His radar confirms a sharp eye for goal and high shot accuracy, yet his zero key passes and minimal duels won reveal a passive role in build-up play, relying entirely on his teammates to create opportunities. This tactical profile underscores his function as a pure finisher rather than a creator, maximizing his impact through positioning and composure in the box while contributing little to the team's offensive structure.
